content:
Apple TV is getting a head start on the holidays, announcing today that two new holiday specials are on the way, along with free viewing offers for several beloved Peanuts titles. Details below:

New Peanuts and Muppet adventure holiday specials, a family film starring Chris Pratt, and more are coming to Apple TV

Apple has two new holiday specials this year for two of its most beloved brands:

  • 'Snoopy's Presents: A Snoopy Twelve Days of Christmas' premieres Friday, November 13
  • 'Muppet Adventure: Holiday Gifts' follows on Friday, December 4

Each new film will add to the existing Peanuts and Muppet libraries already on Apple TV.

Alongside its holiday programming announcement, Apple TV also highlighted the new family film 'Way of the Warrior Kid.' The film debuts on Wednesday, November 25, and stars Chris Pratt and Linda Cardellini. While not holiday-themed, Apple enjoys debuting new family films around Thanksgiving each year. A description of the film is below:

In addition to this year's new specials, Apple will also be offering free viewing of several beloved Peanuts holiday specials on select weekends later this year. The dates are:

  • 'Snoopy! The Great Pumpkin': October 17-18
  • 'A Charlie Brown Thanksgiving': November 14-15
  • 'A Charlie Brown Christmas': December 12-13

Apple TV subscribers can stream these specials anytime throughout the year, but on the dates above, they are free for everyone.

Other holiday recommendations I'd personally suggest include Apple's musical comedy 'Spirited,' starring Ryan Reynolds and Will Ferrell, as well as 'Hannah Waddingham: Home for Christmas' — a perfect pick for Ted Lasso fans.

What is your favorite holiday special on Apple TV? Let us know in the comments.

Apple TV costs $14.99 per month, but you can also get a discount with the Apple One bundle.
